title.narrative: GHG Emissions Reductions in Targeted Industrial Sub-Sectors through EE and Application of Solar Thermal Systems in Malaysia

description.narrative: The proposed project aims to support the reduction of fossil CO2 emissions in Malaysia#s industry in general, and in particular, in selected industrial sub-sectors, by improving energy efficiency in industrial heating processes and process optimization, and the u tilization of solar thermal energy whenever applicable and feasible. As a result of the proposed project intervention, Malaysia will have improved regulations and financial incentive mechanisms (grant and non-grant instruments) and strengthened technical and institutional capabilities for the development, financing and implementation of solar thermal energy applications and energy efficiency improvements in industry on a sustainable basis.
